summary: Iteration 31: Backend-only testing of F&O Signal Engine Batch 1-3 implementation. All 6 new service modules import correctly. 39/40 backend tests pass (1 flaky test due to API timeout). Fixed 2 bugs in mfe_mae_engine.py (idxmax() returning Timestamp instead of int). Index constituents DB has 62 records (50 NIFTY + 12 BANKNIFTY). News sentiment engine fetches 112+ headlines. All Confluence Score V2 buckets (A/B/C/D) compute correctly. Frontend loads without errors.

minor.issue: Fixed: idxmax() was returning Timestamp instead of int position - changed to argmax()

critical_code_review_comments: The mfe_mae_engine.py had bugs where idxmax()/idxmin() were used assuming integer index, but DataFrames with DatetimeIndex return Timestamp. Fixed by using argmax()/argmin() on .values array.
All new modules are pure Python computation with no LLM numeric work as specified in Master Spec.
research_engine.py correctly re-exports all new functions from Batch 1-3 modules.
